chart_references: OpenAI and Google also seem to be going after different kinds of advertisers. Google’s Direct Offers allow companies to promote a discount code for a product the user is researching in AI Mode. OpenAI, meanwhile, is focused on brand-building ads designed to burnish a firm’s image rather than trigger a click. So far 81% of its ads fall into that category, by Similarweb’s analysis. OpenAI may reckon that users deep in a coding or editing session are unlikely to break off to pursue an offer.

extraction.title: The salesman in the machine
extraction.subtitle: Why your AI assistant is suddenly selling to you Sponsored chats are changing the way digital advertising works
extraction.summary: AI chatbots are evolving into sales tools, integrating advertisements into user conversations. This shift poses significant implications for both the AI and advertising industries, as companies like OpenAI and Google explore monetization strategies through ads in chat interactions. Early experiments show varied approaches and user responses, with potential for rapid growth in ad revenue.
